07/19/2021: Station Online:                                              [1445] 
     
            - Station added to Enviroweather/MAWN database system 
          
 
07/16/2021: Data Collection Enabled                                      [1425] 
 
            - Data Collection and Data Archive for new station begins: 
 
                  First data report:   July 17, 2021 (d=198) 00:05 
 
 
07/16/2021: Logger Setup                                                 [1421] 
 
            - Loaded MAWN Program: mar-cssd.cr6 
                                      mar => Station ID (marshfield) 
                                        c => WI (state network) 
                                        s => SDI-12 [CS650] (Soil Moisture) 
                                        s => SDI-12 [HygroVue10] (Temp/RH) 
                                        d => LWS-L (Leaf Wetness) [no canopy] 
                                      cr6 => CR6 (logger / logger program type) 
 
            - Now able to collect raw weather data.

            - Established telecommunication between station cell-modem  
              and data-collection PC/server on campus.
